title: Planning records an open design choice of a new command whose touches guard a rule as a gate before the start
goal: Retrospective of SP-sbdy4hsx: four stories adding provider.py read and search, kbid.py add's licence read and factdiff.py anchor --quotes left the cache location and age, the output shape and cap, the exit codes, the row names and the CSV format open; their touches guard rules, so gate add made each choice a blocking gate mid-work (14 gates over 4 workers), each worker stopped and the orchestrator answered them before the landing. backlog.py precheck SP warns of a committed item whose touches guard a rule and whose goal adds a subcommand or flag with no gate naming its output, exit codes and any cache, and the kb-sprint skill's plan step 6 names the warning; a test runs precheck on a planted sprint and finds the warning, and none for an item that has the gates.

run:
import sys,tempfile,subprocess,io,contextlib,argparse,os
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_base,bl_land
def one(**v):
    return {'BG-bbbbbbbb': v}
def run(sg,items,files=()):
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True)
    for p,t in files:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d,p)),exist_ok=True)
        open(os.path.join(d,p),'w').write(t)
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'add','-A'],check=True)
    bl=bl_base.Backlog(d)
    bl.items['SP-aaaaaaaa']=dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa',kind='sprint',title='s',status='planned',goal=sg)
    for k,v in items.items():
        it=dict(id=k,sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',status='draft',title='t',checks=[dict(run=['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)'])])
        it.update(v)
        bl.items[k]=it
    o=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(o):
        bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl,argparse.Namespace(sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa'))
    return [l for l in o.getvalue().splitlines() if l.startswith('warning')]
touches=['AGENTS.md','_tools/provider.py']
bad=run('g',one(kind='story',goal='provider.py gains a read subcommand that prints a cached page.',touches=touches))
quiet=run('g',one(kind='story',goal='provider.py words a message again.',touches=touches))
sys.exit(0 if any('BG-bbbbbbbb' in l and 'gate' in l.lower() for l in bad) and not any('BG-bbbbbbbb' in l for l in quiet) else 1)
